title: Accumulator tracks the output word
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\mathrm{upd}$ update an auxiliary value from an optional Boolean symbol. Suppose $\sigma$ assigns an auxiliary value to each Boolean word and satisfies $\sigma(u\mathbin{+}b)=\mathrm{upd}(\sigma(u),b)$ for every Boolean word $u$ and optional Boolean symbol $b$, where $u\mathbin{+}b$ denotes appending $b$ when present. For every clock bound $N$ and configuration $c$, the auxiliary value returned by the windowed run started with $\sigma$ of the initial output word equals $\sigma$ of the output word in the returned configuration.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols
An update function on auxiliary values and optional Boolean symbols
A summary function $\sigma$ on Boolean words
The recurrence $\sigma(u\mathbin{+}b)=\mathrm{upd}(\sigma(u),b)$ for all words $u$ and optional symbols $b$
